q1_issues.issue: The noun "urgency" is re-expressed as the adjective urgent on an invented reified state, collapsing a derivational pair the naming rule forbids collapsing (inflection only, never derivation).
"of this" is attached as (Experiencer sk_urgent_1 sk_request_1) — the nominalization's of-argument is turned into a state's holder rather than staying on the noun's own symbol.

"this" is resolved cataphorically to "this request", which is mentioned only in the later clause; coreference is defined over already-introduced antecedents, so no antecedent is available at that point.

q2_gaps: a deadjectival nominalization used as an argument ("the urgency of this") — the of-phrase rules cover act/result nominalizations with an underlying verb and true relational nouns, not quality nominals
first-person (speaker) reference "I" — the pronoun rule enumerates he/she/it/they and their objectives, and gives no class or symbol for a speaker or addressee
a bare direct quotation with no attributing clause — the quoted utterance is asserted as fact, and there is no licensed frame for "this was said"
notes: The two clauses are correctly translated independently with no connective atom, each negation is one strength-0 conjunction, and "am not going to grant" correctly puts Future inside the denial with the definite request typed at top level.
